boundary_decision.rationale: The root is a versioned marketing-campaign aggregate. Generic campaign, organization, brand, market, party, audience, consent, offer, promotion, advertisement, creative, activity, communication, placement, contract, finance, observation, experiment, sales and records masters remain external.

decisions.rationale: One campaign can bind marketing purpose, audience, proposition, plan, budget, measurement, execution and learning evidence without absorbing adjacent masters.
The unified registry supplies a generic Campaign parent hint but the frozen relation ledger has no settled WM-ECO-027 edge, so it grants no containment or cascade authority.

decisions.concept: Campaign, revision, wave, activity, placement, communication and interaction
decisions.rationale: The campaign coordinates references and intended structure; every executed occurrence keeps its own identity, state, source and clocks.
The campaign owns purpose-scoped intended-audience criteria and bindings, not person identity, universal segment membership, consent, preference or suppression authority.

decisions.concept: Proposition, offer, promotion, advertisement and creative
decisions.rationale: The campaign binds exact revisions and records approvals while subject, offer, promotion, advertisement and creative lifecycles remain external.

decisions.concept: Objective, hypothesis, metric, measurement, attribution and causality
decisions.rationale: Each carries its own definition, method, scope, evidence, uncertainty and time. Attribution remains model-relative and cannot prove causality.
Planned, approved, allocated, committed, incurred and actual amounts remain distinct, while contracts, purchases, invoices, payments and ledgers stay authoritative elsewhere.
Campaign state never proves delivery, impression, viewability, reach, response, conversion, lead, opportunity, customer, revenue or business outcome.
Purpose, lawful basis, consent, preference, objection, suppression and channel permission remain separate. Legal and regulatory sources are scoped profiles.
Audience, content, ad-product, transparency and measurement standards support paid digital advertising but cannot narrow the model to that channel.
TM Forum, IAB, Schema.org, privacy, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI cover different facets and never replace the canonical campaign aggregate.

decisions.concept: Single-provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

deferred_research: Canonically adjudicate the WM-ACT-028 parent signal and register relations to audience, consent, offer, promotion, advertisement, creative, activity, communication, placement, finance, observation, experiment and sales models.
Create consumer, business, public-sector, fundraising, political, advocacy, recruitment, event, retail, lifecycle, loyalty, partner and regulated-sector campaign profiles.
Benchmark and conformance-test audience, identity-resolution, frequency, KPI, attribution, incrementality, invalid-traffic and optimization methods.
Validate jurisdiction, channel, consent, suppression, profiling, competition, claims, children, political advertising, accessibility, privacy and records policies.
Pin exact TM Forum and IAB release artefacts and validate mappings against concrete implementations.
Obtain independent external research, marketing operations, measurement, privacy, legal, finance and data-governance review before promotion beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-027 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-ACT-028 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-027 edge.
Identity hold: marketing campaign, revision, wave, flight, activity, placement, communication and interaction remain distinct.
Audience hold: population, segment definition, selected audience, reached party, respondent, lead, opportunity and customer remain distinct and source qualified.
Methodology hold: objectives, KPIs, denominators, attribution, identity resolution, deduplication, experiments, incrementality and optimization require organization and channel validation.
Causality hold: attribution is model-relative and a causal claim requires explicit design, assignment, control, contamination and uncertainty evidence.
Privacy hold: purpose, lawful basis, consent, preference, objection, suppression and channel permission remain separate and jurisdiction scoped.
Bias and targeting hold: audience sources and models require minimisation, recency, provenance, fairness, explanation, prohibited-attribute and protected-group controls.
Financial hold: planned, approved, allocated, committed, incurred and actual budget or cost remain separate from contract, invoice, payment and ledger masters.
Source-access hold: several TM Forum pages were verified through official indexed content while direct automated access was publisher-blocked; TMF699 version labelling is inconsistent.
Profile hold: digital advertising, direct marketing, events, retail, advocacy, fundraising, political, recruitment, business and regulated-sector campaigns need separate profiles.
Interoperability hold: every TM Forum, IAB, Schema.org, privacy, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI projection needs release pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
